thirstwastaken2.config.subtitle: Settings
thirstwastaken2.config.thirst_depletion_: How fast thirst drains outside the Nether, before biome climate is applied.
When off, thirst slowly refills instead of draining on Peaceful difficulty.
thirstwastaken2.config.dehydration_halts: Blocks natural health regeneration while thirst is not full.
thirstwastaken2.config.quenched_health_r: How fast quenched heals you while thirst is full, as a share of how fast saturation heals. 0% turns it off.
thirstwastaken2.config.quenched_heal_min: Quenched only heals while food is at least this, in half shanks. 10 is five shanks, 0 heals even when starving.
thirstwastaken2.config.cold_sweat_climat: With Cold Sweat installed, thirst drains by the temperature it measures around you, hearths and shade included, instead of the biome's.
thirstwastaken2.config.serene_seasons_cl: With Serene Seasons installed, thirst drains faster or slower with the season, and a tropical biome's dry season counts as dry. Deserts, jungles and other biomes the seasons never warm or cool are left alone.
thirstwastaken2.config.season_drain_spri: How fast thirst drains in the middle of spring, as a share of the usual speed. The speed moves smoothly from one season's middle to the next.
thirstwastaken2.config.season_drain_summ: How fast thirst drains in the middle of summer, as a share of the usual speed. The speed moves smoothly from one season's middle to the next.
thirstwastaken2.config.season_drain_autu: How fast thirst drains in the middle of autumn, as a share of the usual speed. The speed moves smoothly from one season's middle to the next.
thirstwastaken2.config.season_drain_wint: How fast thirst drains in the middle of winter, as a share of the usual speed. The speed moves smoothly from one season's middle to the next.
thirstwastaken2.config.prevent_sprinting: Stops sprinting once thirst drops to 6 or below.
thirstwastaken2.config.can_drink_by_hand: Sneak and use an empty hand on water to drink directly from it.
thirstwastaken2.config.quenched_percent_: The share of a drink's quenched that water of this grade gives.
The share of a drink's quenched that water of this grade gives.
The share of a drink's quenched that water of this grade gives.
The share of a drink's quenched that water of this grade gives.
Ocean and beach water is salty and makes you thirstier. Off, it is graded like any other water.
thirstwastaken2.config.sea_water_nausea_: How long a drink of sea water gives Nausea. 0 gives none.
thirstwastaken2.config.sea_water_parched: How long a drink of sea water leaves you Parched. 0 gives none.
thirstwastaken2.config.enable_rain_colle: Rain fills hanging pots and grades the water it leaves in a cauldron. Off, pots ignore rain and cauldron rain water has no grade.
The grade of rain collected in a cauldron or hanging pot.
The grade of water a pointed dripstone drips into a cauldron.
thirstwastaken2.config.default_purity.to: Purity used for water that carries no purity of its own.
What a drink of bad water gives, for each difficulty and grade.
thirstwastaken2.config.extend_sickness_e: Drinking bad water while an effect from it is still on adds its time again, up to twice as long. Off, the longer of the two is kept.
thirstwastaken2.config.sickness.chance.t: Chance, 0 to 100, that a drink gives this effect. Each effect rolls on its own.
How many seconds the effect lasts.
thirstwastaken2.config.sickness.reset_gr: Put back this grade's default effects
thirstwastaken2.config.sickness.unknown: No installed mod adds %s, so it is skipped. It stays in the file.
thirstwastaken2.config.sickness.add.tool: Adds the effect to this grade at 100%, 10 seconds, level 1, to edit above. The grey text completes the id.
thirstwastaken2.config.appleskin_missing: AppleSkin is not installed, so these settings do nothing for now.
thirstwastaken2.config.appleskin_quenche: Colour of the quenched outline on the thirst bar and in tooltips. Off removes the outline and the exhaustion strip from the bar.
thirstwastaken2.config.appleskin_tooltip: Show the thirst and quenched droplet rows in item tooltips.
thirstwastaken2.config.mod_items_reload: Changes here apply after /reload or rejoining the world. A dedicated server needs a restart.
thirstwastaken2.config.enable_bowls.tool: The clay, terracotta and water bowls. Off, they cannot be crafted and leave the creative tab. Bowls that already exist keep working.
Off, it cannot be crafted and leaves the creative tab. One that already exists keeps working.
thirstwastaken2.config.enable_copper_can: Off, it cannot be crafted and leaves the creative tab. One that already exists keeps working.
thirstwastaken2.config.enable_iron_flask: Off, it cannot be crafted or cleaned in a furnace, and leaves the creative tab. One that already exists keeps working.
thirstwastaken2.config.enable_copper_han: Off, it cannot be crafted and leaves the creative tab. A pot already placed keeps working.
thirstwastaken2.config.enable_iron_hangi: Off, it cannot be crafted and leaves the creative tab. A pot already placed keeps working.
thirstwastaken2.config.enable_copper_dis: The distiller and its four parts. Off, they cannot be crafted and leave the creative tab. A distiller already placed stays.
thirstwastaken2.config.copper_canteen_ca: How many drinks it holds when full. One that already holds more keeps its water.
thirstwastaken2.config.iron_flask_capaci: How many drinks it holds when full. One that already holds more keeps its water.
thirstwastaken2.config.enable_boiling_in: Hold use with a Copper Canteen or Iron Flask on a lit campfire to boil its water.
thirstwastaken2.config.copper_canteen_bo: Seconds each drink takes to boil over a campfire.
thirstwastaken2.config.iron_flask_boil_s: Seconds each drink takes to boil over a campfire.
thirstwastaken2.config.copper_hanging_po: Seconds each drink takes to boil over a campfire.
thirstwastaken2.config.iron_hanging_pot_: Seconds each drink takes to boil over a campfire.
thirstwastaken2.config.distiller_serving: Seconds each drink takes to distil while the fire burns.
thirstwastaken2.config.distiller_tank_se: How many drinks the boiler and the basin each hold. Three make a bucket.
thirstwastaken2.config.enable_drink_tag_: Items their own mod tags as drinks restore thirst even when the config does not list them.
thirstwastaken2.config.enable_keyword_ma: Guesses thirst values for unknown modded items from their registry name.
thirstwastaken2.config.item_values.hidde: %s listed items belong to mods that are not installed and are hidden here. Their values stay in the file.
thirstwastaken2.config.item_values.thirs: Thirst points restored, 0 to 20. Each droplet on the bar is two.
thirstwastaken2.config.item_values.quenc: Quenched points, 0 to 20: how long the drink holds off draining.
thirstwastaken2.config.item_values.enabl: Restores thirst. Click to switch the item off.
thirstwastaken2.config.item_values.disab: Switched off: restores nothing, whatever else gives it a value. Click to switch it back on.
thirstwastaken2.config.item_values.add.t: Lists the item with the value tagged drinks get, to edit below. The grey text completes the id.
thirstwastaken2.message.cannot_boil_salt: Boiling cannot take the salt out
